about: A cut of the findings ledger as gh-pages published it after the A11y nightly of 2026-11-10 (commit 67c2974e47, version 1), for .github/scripts/__tests__/a11y-learn.test.mjs: the night one class added to one span made 59 rows look new. after: that night and the one before it, and every row of the dropdown-menu and auto-link pages that was new or resolved that night, as published. before: the previous night as the state published before it kept it (commit 44e2b5d789), its coverage cut to those two pages. gitLog: git log --first-parent --diff-merges=first-parent --name-only --format=%x1e%H%x1f%s 1d5365bd3c..8b36d60903, cut like the other fixture's. catalog: the clusters of tests/a11y/issues.json these rows fall into, as that file had them when the fixture was cut.

clusters.title: Text, icon, checkbox, grid line, selection and focus indicator contrast under 4.5:1 or 3:1 per theme
Links and checkboxes are smaller than 24 by 24 px, or sit closer than that to their neighbors
